name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner shadow at 20% opacity. This makes the focus indicator visible on all backgrounds while keeping it compact enough for mobile touch targets. The inner shadow softens the edge so it doesn’t clash with high-contrast designs. Trade-off: the thicker ring takes slightly more space, but the glow effect compensates by ensuring visibility without bulk.

name: Reader
text: A 3px solid ring with inner shadow still risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds or when the user’s OS/browser overrides focus styles. A 2px ring with a 30% glow at 4px spread passes WCAG 2.1 AA on all backgrounds and survives OS-level contrast overrides. Test it on a busy desktop wallpaper and a low-contrast mobile lock screen—if the glow remains visible, the decision is settled.
